display.purpose: Homepage opener in solid ivory. Responsive and short-viewport overrides are recorded in DESIGN.md.

headline.purpose: ENG-026 solid ink or ivory ordinary words with selected weight-750 gradient keywords and pale lilac highlights; replaces ENG-025 all-over heading gradients.

interior-display.purpose: Public page heroes outside the homepage.

body.purpose: Base Inter reading text; public leads use the larger role.

label.purpose: Readable control and factual metadata; not decorative eyebrows.

arabic-display.purpose: Independent Noto Sans Arabic metrics and zero tracking.

arabic-headline.purpose: Independent current chapter scale with zero tracking and 1.48 line height.

benefit-title.purpose: Bold title within a tactile reading article; Arabic uses zero tracking and a 1.6 line box.

photo-hero-title.purpose: Bold solid ivory photographic headers; only the final phrase of a multi-phrase heading carries the inverse gradient. One-phrase titles remain solid. Participation uses weight 750 and independent Arabic metrics.

public-gold-label.purpose: Public gold variant only; weight 700 in the heading family, zero Arabic tracking.

shadows.name: floating-masthead
shadows.purpose: Grain-glass navigation edge and soft offset separation.

shadows.name: navigation-menu
shadows.purpose: Dropdown and mobile navigation panel depth.

shadows.name: champagne-hover
shadows.purpose: Warm offset response to a fine pointer.

shadows.name: date-panel-response
shadows.purpose: Light conference-day panel on hover or focus within.

motion.name: feedback
motion.purpose: Shared control feedback, with reduced-motion suppression.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-time progressive reveal with 12px travel; no-JavaScript and reduced-motion content remain readable.

motion.name: action-fill
motion.purpose: Shared non-champagne button fill from the reading edge; RTL reverses direction.

motion.name: navigation-geometry
motion.purpose: Continuous glass with reversible outward travel. Upward scroll restores navigation; pointer approach does not. Open dropdown and keyboard-visible focus preserve access.

motion.name: navigation-middle
motion.purpose: Coordinated middle opacity with 8px rise and .96 scale. Keyboard restoration is synchronous.

motion.name: navigation-dropdown
motion.purpose: Origin-aware dropdown feedback with a 140ms cancelable pointer-leave allowance and a real gap bridge; Program remains a direct link.

motion.name: photographic-hover
motion.purpose: Current pathway (750ms) and gallery (900ms) scale treatments. Anonymous portraits do not use photo hover effects.

motion.name: faq-icon
motion.purpose: Native disclosure plus changes to the open state.

motion.name: hero-line
motion.purpose: One-time title entrance with 80ms second-line delay; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: navigation-blur
motion.purpose: Brief plate/middle blur during outward transition; background glass is 24px blur and .80-.86 alpha. Reduced motion suppresses middle blur.

motion.name: research-drift
motion.purpose: Small decorative artwork drift; runs only while visible, the document is visible, motion is allowed and visitor pause is false.

motion.name: history-count
motion.purpose: One-shot quartic ease-out from observed entry. Accessible final text remains constant; reduced motion shows final values immediately.

motion.name: history-count-focus
motion.purpose: Brief 5px blur and 8px rise into focus; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: paper-sheet
motion.purpose: 65svh native overlap, 35svh below 800px; reduced motion uses static normal document flow.

motion.name: champagne-highlight
motion.purpose: Interruptible highlight sweep; immediate for keyboard focus.

motion.name: champagne-press
motion.purpose: Subtle .975 press scale; reduced motion removes travel.

motion.name: benefit-panel
motion.purpose: 3px pointer lift, pictogram response and separate 240ms inset light. Articles remain non-interactive reading surfaces.

motion.name: speaker-contour-entrance
motion.purpose: One brief decorative entrance, permanently settled after 4.5s; unseen motion pauses, reduced motion is static, no new pause control.

motion.name: photo-hero-hover
motion.purpose: Photographic public header scale 1.015 to 1.045 beneath stationary text and 5px blur.

motion.name: conference-day-link
motion.purpose: Hover and press on actual matching-day Program destinations; focus and reduced motion are immediate.

motion.name: ambient-artwork-settle
motion.purpose: Brief arrival of exact curve/ellipse linework on paths, benefits and people surfaces. Reduced motion is static; no added pause control.

motion.name: participation-card-response
motion.purpose: 3px pointer lift on reading cards with a separate 220ms shadow response; focusable resources retain immediate keyboard feedback.

motion.name: pathway-index-color
motion.purpose: Native scroll changes the current track's color and arrow opacity. Underline and aria-current communicate location independently of color; keyboard and reduced motion are immediate.

motion.name: pathway-index-marker
motion.purpose: A 4px directional arrow resolves beside the current pathway. Native anchor links and scrolling remain intact; RTL mirrors the arrow.
